_note: DEMO RANKED-LIST BOARD. Per plan Q11, layout `ranked-list` renders ONE column of answer rows ordered by descending value, each row hidden until the host reveals it. That is why this board declares exactly one column: the column label is the survey question, and the cells are its ranked answers. The point numbers below are INVENTED for the demo — no real survey was consulted, and none is implied. Strikes and steals are host-mediated and not modeled anywhere in code (spec §10 F9); the host awards these points with the same team controls jeopardy uses. Cells carry `answer` and `value` because those are feud.json's requiredCellFields — a ranked answer needs no separate prompt, the question is the column label.
title: Quiz Board Engine Demo — Ranked Answers
